user_reviews.Name: Aleksandr Safronov
user_reviews.Description:
I want to leave an honest review of Lisbon Smile.

To be fair, the quality of treatment was good, and the doctors were polite and professional.
However, the clinic has serious operational issues that affected my overall experience.

The biggest problem is refund handling.
My insurance covers 70% of treatment costs, but even after insurance confirmation, the clinic keeps the money for too long instead of refunding it promptly.

The process repeatedly follows the same pattern:
• I have to send reminder emails,
• the clinic asks again for bank details I had already provided,
• the refund is still delayed,
• and I’m encouraged to leave the balance for future treatment.

From a patient’s perspective, this looks like systematic delay rather than a clear and transparent reimbursement process.

There are also scheduling issues: even when arriving on time, waiting times can be long, and this can stretch the treatment timeline.

So yes, the treatment itself was good — but the administrative side (especially refunds) was not.
Patients should not have to chase their own money.

user_reviews.Name: Mrs Andre
user_reviews.Description: I had an appointment in February to discuss the possibility of removing a partial tooth that cracked years ago and also to discuss the possibilities of Invisalign. The receptionist who booked my appointment told me the costs would be €85 to the do X-ray and to speak with the Dentist about the treatment plan. I didn’t want to spend a lot of money because two months prior I went to another dental office to do the same X-rays so this visit was for me to get a second opinion and compare prices to make a decision. After speaking with the dentist and now ready to pay, I was told the price was €195. I was greatly confused because I was quoted €85. They told me because they had to perform 2 separate different X-rays the costs was higher. My problem is, if I had been informed before the extra set of X-rays of the prices to do so, I would’ve had the option to say yes or no. I was not given an option. I was under the impression that everything that I was doing was standard procedure and included the €85/ visit that I was originally quoted. I value transparency especially at medical offices because I know how quickly extra costs can be added. So for €195, I went for X-rays and to briefly talk about treatments. No cleanings or anything else. My main problem was the partial tooth inside my gums is infected and they wouldn’t write me a prescription to treat the infection because the dentist want me to consult with the orthodontist about aligners first. The orthodontist was out on pregnancy leave and wouldn’t be back for another 2-3 months. I waited awhile to write my experience because I wasn’t going to but I decided that l would tell my experience because I always appreciate honest reviews when I’m looking for services. Personally I wouldn’t go back because I like to know everything up front and the transparency was not there.
